title: 和为 K 的子数组
statement: 给定整数数组 nums 和整数 k，统计和恰好等于 k 的子数组个数。子数组是数组中连续、非空的一段。

en.title: Subarray Sum Equals K
en.statement: Given an integer array nums and an integer k, count the number of subarrays whose sum is exactly k. A subarray is a contiguous, non-empty segment of the array.

complexity.space: O(n) extra space (hash table counting prefix sums)
complexity.notes: n is the array length. The sum of subarray (i, j] is pre[j] - pre[i]; while iterating, look up how many times pre[j] - k has appeared in the hash table; hashing is O(1) on average. The array contains negative numbers, so a sliding window does not work. When all elements are 0 and k = 0, the answer reaches n(n+1)/2 ≈ 2×10^8, which still fits in a 32-bit integer.

en.acmIoSpec: stdin: line 1 has n and k; line 2 has n integers nums. stdout: one integer, the number of subarrays with sum k.

complexity.time: O(n) 平均时间（本地训练目标）
complexity.space: O(n) 额外空间（前缀和计数哈希表）
complexity.officialRequirement: 官方未强制复杂度要求。
complexity.notes: n 为数组长度。子数组 (i, j] 的和为 pre[j] - pre[i]，遍历时在哈希表中查询 pre[j] - k 出现的次数；哈希为平均 O(1)。数组含负数，不能用滑动窗口。全 0 且 k = 0 时答案达 n(n+1)/2 ≈ 2×10^8，仍在 32 位整数范围内。

cpp.acmIoSpec: stdin：第一行 n 和 k；第二行 n 个整数 nums。stdout：一个整数，和为 k 的子数组个数。
